## Summary

Describe the change and the user or protocol outcome.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests or documentation checks pass.
- [ ] Canonical x402/Stellar compatibility was considered.
- [ ] Security, privacy and operational impact was reviewed.
- [ ] New dependencies comply with `DEPENDENCY_POLICY.md`.
- [ ] Grant claims and evidence were updated if applicable.

## Evidence

Link tests, transaction hashes, screenshots or design decisions without exposing secrets or personal data.
